g.title: critical_transmission_buses
g.text: Eight critical added buses — transmission-focused alternative
148 total buses = all140 original +8 additions;54 NY buses =46 original +8. Local change view; full backbone retained.
Blue boxes: eight added345kV buses. Gray boxes: original NPCC terminals.
Purple dotted:30 DC equivalents of omitted detail
Equivalent connections are not individual physical lines and are not DLR-qualified. xN = parallel circuit count. Schematic layout.
